company.name: Qualtrics
company.shortDescription: Qualtrics is a single system of record for all experience data, managing customer, product, employee, and brand experiences on one platform.
company.description: Qualtrics is a single system of record for all experience data, managing customer, product, employee, and brand experiences on one platform. The company's experience data, also called X-data, allows organizations to manage the four core experiences of business—customer, product, employee, and brand experiences—on one platform. Over 8,500 enterprises worldwide, including more than 75 percent of the Fortune 100 and 99 of the top 100 U.S. business schools, rely on Qualtrics.

aiResearchSummary.text: Qualtrics is researching systems for generating action plans from perception gap data for interaction events and determining responses to real time user events utilizing user profile attributes. It develops digital survey creation by providing optimized suggested content and utilizing a knowledge graph to implement a digital survey system, including determining and applying attribute definitions to digital survey data, anomaly detection in ongoing data collection, and using machine learning to segment unstructured text and organize survey text responses. These efforts span survey optimization, analytics, and intelligent experience management.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $1,000,000,000, or 71.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,000,000,000 to $2,500,000,000, a 2.5x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 23 (-43 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
